content.title: Where to watch #1 Duke vs. #16 Siena NCAA 1st-round game today on free streams, TV
content.text: Where to watch #1 Duke vs. #16 Siena NCAA 1st-round game today on free streams, TV Dustin Hockensmith - pennlive.com (TNS) Mar 19, 2026 Mar 19, 2026 Facebook Twitter Email Print Copy article link The top-seeded Duke Blue Devils kick off the 2026 NCAA Men’s Basketball Tournament on Thursday with a first-round matchup with No. 16 Siena. The game is scheduled to start at 2:50 p.m. ET with TV coverage on CBS and streaming on-demand . How to watch #1 Duke vs. #16 Siena on TV and stream without cable: When:Thursday, March 19 at 2:50 p.m. ET Where:Bon Secours Wellness Arena, Greenville, S.C. TV channel:CBS and Paramount+ Streaming on: FuboTV (free trial) | DirecTV (free trial) | Paramount+ (free trial) #1 Duke vs. #16 Siena: The matchup Duke is the No. 1 overall seed for the NCAA Tournament with a complete body of work that was recognized in the Blue Devils’ No. 1 NET Ranking, a 17-2 record against Quad 1 teams and a perfect 15-0 mark against Quad 2 and below. Duke is powered by a group that ranks No. 3 nationally in scoring defense (63.1 ppg), No. 9 in field goal percentage defense (39.2%) and No. 5 in rebound margin (+10.9). Duke won the ACC regular-season and tournament titles behind Wooden Award contender freshman forward Cameron Boozer, who leads the team in scoring (22.5 ppg), rebounds (10.2 rpg) and assists (4.2 apg) and has started all 34 games. See also: March Madness coverage on PennLive Siena opens as a 27.5-point underdog, which is the second-biggest point spread of Day 1, after reaching the tournament with a 23-11 overall record and a Metro Atlantic Athletic Conference Championship with a 64-54 win over No. 1 seed Merrimack in the title game. The Saints will see a likely-overwhelming level of size and athleticism after losing their only Quad 1 game of the season, 81-60, to a non-NCAA Tournament qualifier in Indiana, but they do allow just 65.7 points per game, the 15th-lowest mark in the country. #1 Duke vs. #16 Siena: Know your live streams FuboTV (free trial) : FuboTV offers the most extensive package of live sports with rates competitive with DirecTV. The FuboTV Pro ($48.99 first month), Elite ($53.99) and Deluxe ($73.99) all come with first-month discounts. Monthly rates rise to $73.99, $83.99 and $103.99 after the first-month discount.
